findings.title: Potentially Unbounded Loop
findings.description: Function 'func_48' contains a loop block with no conditional branch (br_if) or return instruction detected. This may represent an unbounded loop that exhausts the Soroban instruction budget and causes contract failure.
findings.recommendation: Ensure all loops have a deterministic termination condition. Soroban enforces a per-transaction instruction budget — unbounded loops will trap.
findings.evidence: Loop depth: 2, br_if: false, return: false
